title: DORA Community Discussion - Decoding DORA 2025: AI’s Real Impact
summary: Walkthrough of DORA 2025: near-universal AI use, throughput now up but instability persists, and AI amplifies existing organizational strengths and weaknesses.

assertions.quote: we found that 90% of people are using AI to some extent

verdicts.note: Stack Overflow 2025: ~84% use or plan to use AI tools, about half of professionals daily; JetBrains and DORA report similar figures.

assertions.quote: when we use more AI, it seems to be making things a bit more unstable.

verdicts.note: DORA 2025 reports AI adoption now positively associated with throughput while still associated with higher delivery instability (change failure and rework).

assertions.quote: most people are finding that it's having a generally positive impact on code quality.

verdicts.note: DORA 2025 found ~59% reporting positive quality impact; it's self-report, which other studies show overstates measured effects.

assertions.quote: it doesn't seem to be solving problems of friction and burnout. Um which is something which is strange

verdicts.note: DORA 2025 found no measurable effect of AI on burnout or friction, but this rests on survey data from one research program.

assertions.quote: These are the three things that are going to uh have the most impact on our product performance.

verdicts.note: These come from DORA's 2025 AI capabilities model, a survey-based correlational analysis; plausible and consistent with older DORA findings on small batches, but not causal evidence.

assertions.quote: AI is an amplifier. So, uh, it doesn't make things that are bad good.

verdicts.note: DORA 2025 data shows AI outcomes depend on surrounding capabilities, which supports the framing, though 'amplifier' is an interpretation of correlational survey results.

assertions.quote: It's no good just being individually productive. You need to make your whole end to-end system productive.

verdicts.note: DORA 2024/25 and Faros 2025 found individual output up while organizational delivery metrics stayed flat or worsened; review and integration become the bottleneck.

assertions.quote: as the quality of the platform reaches a certain level that's when you start to see that it's benefiting the organization

verdicts.note: DORA 2025 reports this association, but it is correlational survey evidence and platform quality is hard to separate from overall engineering maturity.
